name: Elmify
degreeScope: Master's degrees (MSc, MA, LLM, MRes) and second-cycle scholarships are live today. Bachelor's degree support will be done soon.
description: Elmify reads official university and scholarship regulations across 50+ countries in English, Azerbaijani, and Russian for master's degrees (MSc, MA, LLM, MRes — Bachelor's coming soon), checks your GPA, ECTS credits, and IELTS or TOEFL scores against State Program (Dövlət Proqramı), HTP, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Chevening, tuition waivers, regional grants, and RA/TA assistantships, and builds tailored CVs, motivation letters, and referee briefs from your verified record.
